en.topic_title: Woman charged with murder after fight at minibus stop leaves passenger dead
en.topic_summary:
A woman has been charged with murder following a fatal fight with a female passenger at a minibus stop.



The Eastern Law Courts Building. Photo: Almond Li/HKFP. 



Tian Xiaoying, a 50-year-old cleaner, appeared at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Friday morning. 



Wearing a pair of black-rimmed glasses and a black-coloured jacket, she looked unsettled and spoke softly when the court asked if she understood the details of the alleged offence, local media reported.
